title: asphodeliris japonica
intro: Asphodeliris japonica, commonly known as the Asphodel iris or Japanese Iris, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Iridaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Asphodeliris japonica include its antipyretic, antitussive, and expectorant properties, which help to lower body temperature, relieve cough, and promote the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
